draft.subject: Embedded and Low Level Software Openings | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing about the embedded and low level software engineering openings at Interclypse. You manage programs there, so you would know where an embedded engineer is needed right now rather than in general.

My work has been firmware and systems software, and a fair amount of it has been integration. I wrote monitoring firmware for a microcontroller at the bare metal level and kept it inside a very small memory footprint at a steady update rate. On my graduate capstone I owned a robotic pick and place system across a mobile client, an edge server, and a controller, and tracked down the failures between those layers until it ran cleanly. I also handled the Linux deployment so the software came back on its own.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Program manager, so knows which programs currently need an embedded engineer
